description: Self-contained, offline, quantum-resistant HTML vault for Ethereum seed phrases

stories.title: Project scaffolding with Vite + TypeScript
stories.description: Initialize the project structure with Vite, TypeScript, Vitest, and Playwright. Set up the folder structure as defined in the PRD (src/creator, src/vault, src/shared, tests/unit, tests/e2e). Configure strict TypeScript settings. Add all dependencies from the PRD. Create placeholder entry points.
acceptance_criteria: npm run dev starts Vite dev server
npm run build produces dist/ output
TypeScript compiles with strict mode enabled

stories.title: Shared types and constants
stories.description: Create TypeScript interfaces for Vault, PasswordEncryption, ShamirEncryption, VaultData, SeedEntry, and PathConfig as defined in the PRD data schema. Add constants for supported HD paths (BIP-44, Ledger Legacy, Ledger Live), Argon2 parameter presets, and version numbers.
acceptance_criteria: All interfaces from PRD data schema are defined in src/shared/types.ts
HD path constants include all paths from Appendix A
Argon2 parameter presets match Appendix B recommendations
Types are exported and usable across creator and vault modules
Unit tests verify type guards work correctly

stories.title: BIP-39 mnemonic validation
stories.description: Implement seed phrase validation using @scure/bip39. Support 12, 18, and 24-word phrases. Validate checksum. Normalize input (trim whitespace, lowercase). Return clear error messages for invalid mnemonics.
acceptance_criteria: Rejects invalid checksums with clear error
Rejects non-BIP39 words with clear error
Unit tests cover all validation cases

stories.title: HD path validation and parsing
stories.description: Implement HD derivation path validation. Support hardened (') and non-hardened paths. Validate format matches BIP-32 specification. Provide preset paths for BIP-44, Ledger Legacy, and Ledger Live with index placeholder.
acceptance_criteria: Validates custom paths with correct format
Rejects malformed paths with clear error
Preset paths are selectable by name

stories.title: Argon2id key derivation
stories.description: Implement Argon2id password-based key derivation using @noble/hashes. Security-first parameters: time=4, memory=512MB, parallelism=4. Generate random salt. Return 32-byte key suitable for AES-256. Accept longer derivation times (30-85s on mobile) for maximum brute-force resistance.
acceptance_criteria: Derives consistent key from same password + salt
Progress callback for UI feedback during long derivation

stories.title: ML-KEM-768 + X25519 hybrid key encapsulation
stories.description: Implement hybrid post-quantum key encapsulation using noble-post-quantum. Generate ephemeral ML-KEM-768 keypair. Combine with X25519 for hybrid security. Output encapsulated key and shared secret.
acceptance_criteria: Encapsulation produces ciphertext and shared secret
Hybrid combination with X25519 works correctly

stories.title: AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption
stories.description: Implement AES-256-GCM encryption/decryption using @noble/ciphers. Generate random 12-byte nonce. Encrypt VaultData JSON. Include authentication tag. Handle decryption failures gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: Random nonce generated for each encryption
Authentication tag is verified on decryption
Tampered ciphertext fails decryption with clear error
Wrong key fails decryption with clear error
Unit tests cover success and failure cases

stories.title: Password encryption flow integration
stories.description: Integrate Argon2id, ML-KEM hybrid, and AES-GCM into complete password encryption flow. Input: password + VaultData. Output: Vault object with all encryption metadata. Implement corresponding decryption flow.
acceptance_criteria: encrypt(password, data) returns complete Vault object
Wrong password produces clear error message

stories.title: Shamir secret sharing implementation
stories.description: Implement Shamir's Secret Sharing for k-of-n threshold encryption. Split master key into n shares where any k shares can reconstruct. Validate threshold parameters (k >= 2, n >= k, n <= 10). Format shares in BOTH BIP-39 word format AND hexadecimal for user choice.
acceptance_criteria: Any k shares reconstruct original secret
Fewer than k shares cannot reconstruct
Shares displayed as BIP-39 mnemonic words
Both formats can be used for reconstruction
Unit tests cover threshold edge cases

stories.title: Shamir encryption flow integration
stories.description: Integrate Shamir sharing with ML-KEM and AES-GCM for threshold encryption. Input: threshold config + VaultData. Output: Vault object + array of share strings. Implement corresponding decryption with share input.
acceptance_criteria: encrypt returns Vault + share strings array
decrypt with k shares returns original VaultData
decrypt with k-1 shares fails clearly
Share identifiers stored in vault (not shares themselves)

stories.title: Address derivation from seed + path
stories.description: Implement EVM address derivation using @scure/bip32 and @scure/bip39. Input: mnemonic + passphrase + HD path + count. Output: array of {index, address} objects. Never expose private keys. EVM chains only (Ethereum and compatible networks).
acceptance_criteria: Derives correct addresses for BIP-44 path (m/44'/60'/0'/0/x)
Derives correct addresses for Ledger Legacy path (m/44'/60'/0'/x)
Derives correct addresses for Ledger Live path (m/44'/60'/x'/0/0)
Private keys never appear in output
Supports only EVM-compatible chains (no Bitcoin, Solana, etc.)

stories.title: CSV export for derived addresses
stories.description: Generate CSV export of derived addresses. Columns: seed_label, hd_path, passphrase_hint, address_index, address. Trigger browser download. Never include private keys or actual passphrases.
acceptance_criteria: Generates valid CSV with correct headers
Includes all derived addresses from all paths
passphrase_hint shows '[passphrase set]' or '[none]', never actual passphrase
CSV opens correctly in Excel/Google Sheets

stories.title: Vault HTML template with embedded decryption
stories.description: Create the self-contained HTML vault template. Inline all JavaScript and CSS. Include decryption UI with password/share input. Display decrypted seeds with reveal toggle. Include address derivation and CSV export buttons.
acceptance_criteria: Single HTML file with no external dependencies
Shamir share input (multiple fields based on threshold)
Decrypted data displays with reveal toggle

stories.title: Creator app - seed entry form
stories.description: Build the creator UI for entering seed phrases. Support adding multiple seeds with labels. Validate mnemonics on input. Show validation status. Allow removing seeds.
acceptance_criteria: Add seed form with label and mnemonic fields
Add multiple seeds with unique labels
Remove seed button for each entry
Clear error states on valid input

stories.title: Creator app - HD path configuration
stories.description: Build UI for configuring HD paths per seed. Preset dropdown for BIP-44/Ledger Legacy/Ledger Live. Custom path input option. Optional passphrase field per path. Address count selector (1-100).

stories.title: Creator app - encryption options
stories.description: Build UI for selecting encryption mode. Password mode: password input with confirmation + optional hint. Shamir mode: threshold selector (k-of-n). Show security implications of each choice.
acceptance_criteria: Toggle between Password and Shamir modes

stories.title: Creator app - vault generation and download
stories.description: Implement vault generation flow. Collect all form data. Encrypt with selected mode. Generate self-contained HTML. Trigger download. For Shamir: display shares for user to record.
acceptance_criteria: Shamir mode: displays shares in BOTH BIP-39 words AND hex format
Shamir mode: user can toggle between word/hex display
Shamir mode: warns user to record shares securely
Clears sensitive data from memory after generation

stories.title: E2E tests - full workflow
stories.description: Write Playwright E2E tests covering complete workflows. Test password encryption round-trip. Test Shamir encryption round-trip. Test across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge. Test mobile viewport.
acceptance_criteria: Test: create vault with password, decrypt, verify data
Test: create vault with Shamir 2-of-3, decrypt with 2 shares
Test: derive addresses and verify format
Test: export CSV and verify contents
Tests pass on Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge

stories.title: UI polish - family-friendly design
stories.description: Apply visual design polish. Soft color palette (no dark hacker aesthetic). Clear typography. Friendly iconography. Smooth animations for reveals. Loading states. Empty states.
acceptance_criteria: Color palette is soft and approachable

stories.title: Security hardening and memory clearing
stories.description: Implement security best practices. Clear sensitive data from memory after use. Add CSP headers blocking all network requests. Audit for potential leaks. Add security documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Passwords cleared from memory after key derivation
Decrypted data cleared on page close
No sensitive data in console logs
No sensitive data in error messages
